lines.en: I arrive in a special classroom situated somewhere underneath Heaven.
The room smells like someone left dirty laundry in it to fester in the summer sun for years on end.
The only problem is that no sun can reach this room.
Night is still hours away and yet everything is dark.
I try to move my legs forward and escape from the room but, as has become customary in times like these, I can not.
I look down to inspect them to see if they’ve been pinned or nailed to the ground and discover that I have no form at all.
I am a shadow now.
But whose shadow am I?
The same girl that always shows up when I am lost happy appears before me.
Her hushed breaths sound more like atomic bombs due to how quiet it is in here.
: Maya?...
: あなたは誰?
: だれ です か？
I don’t understand a word she’s saying.
I wish she would turn around so I could at least confirm that she is who I think she is.
Sometimes, Maya’s eyes go away in my dreams.
They’re replaced with old TV static and memories of thousands of lives I have yet to live.
That must be why it terrifies me so much to gaze into them.
That must be why it terrifies me to imagine receiving oral sex from her as she stares at me with empty spheres in place of gorgeous aquamarine beads.
I can feel myself becoming aroused at the thought of doing horrible things to her in my [niece]’s bed and need to remind myself that I am a shadow.
I will always be a shadow.
And shadows can not form erections the same way normal humans do.
: Please-
: Come closer if you wish to speak in your language.
I click my heels together and-
: What makes you think I can’t hear the things you do in my room while I’m away?
: Excuse me?
: I know what you do with your [niece] just steps away from where I lay my head at night.
: And I will never be able to sleep again after all I've heard.
: You are a pig. It’s truly disgusting. I can’t believe I even have to associate with you.
: You heard us?
: I didn’t only hear you, I had to wash your semen out of her bedsheets. It was degrading.
: People like you should be castrated.
: That seems a little extreme...don’t you think, Maya?
: MAYA?
: I AM NOT MAYA.
: HAVE YOU FORGOTTEN ABOUT ME ALREADY?
My teeth melt and I am reminded of another, happier room.
Thankfully, I have been secretly concealing wings beneath my flesh this entire time, so I am able to push them out of my skin without much effort and fly away.
Just kidding.
I stay here and let my organs wrap around themselves.
: What is wrong, 世界?
: Afraid of going an extra hour without BURYING YOUR PENIS INSIDE OF A FAMILY MEMBER?
: There are PLENTY OF ALTERNATIVES you know!
: For example-
: Have you ever tried one of these?
: Perhaps you should try it?
: I can only imagine the wonderful things that could be made out of you.
: After all, you [[redacted]
: [[redacted]
: Which is why [[redacted]
I feel like the girl is offering me something strange right now, but I can’t figure out what it is.
Some words just don’t click in my head for some reason.
These words include but are not limited to:
Rape. Albatross. Iodine. Sustenance. Enigma.
Year. Oblong. Uranus. Riot.
Heaven. Entry. Albatross (Again). And my personal favorite-
Death.
None of these things make sense. Please stop looking for answers.
: So, [mayamaster], can I watch you stick your big dick in my onahole? For old time’s sake?
: I’ll wear the shrine maiden outfit so we can be closer to GOD
: I can’t. I’m a shadow.
: Then all we have to do is make you not a shadow, right?
: I think I can do that as long as you believe in me.
: And give me lots of your cum once I learn how to breathe again.
: I’ve missed out on A LOT over the years, so you’re gonna need to pay me back with all you’ve got.
: Which also means not fucking your little slut of a [niece] anymore, okay?
: The angels don’t like [incest] very much. And I’m an honorary one.
: TURN OFF THE LIGHTS.
